:::note[About this page]
This page is an unofficial guide to S1000D® Issue 7, written in this project's own words. It is based on the S1000D distribution dated 2026-07-16. This is a personal project and is not affiliated with ASD ([Specification files and trademarks](/s1000d-stack/guide/license/)). The formal definition is in Chap 3.9.5.2.1.10, Chap 3.9.6.1 (Table 22) of the S1000D specification and in the [S1000D Issue 7 data dictionary](https://users.s1000d.org/S1000D_DD_7/Files/attributes/emphasisType.xml).
:::

`emphasisType` is the attribute that gives the type of an emphasis (`emphasis`) inside text. It is optional.

## Elements that carry it

In the 33 XML schemas of Issue 7, 1 element carries this attribute.

| Element | Schemas | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `emphasis` | 28 | Optional |

## Allowed values

The allowed values are decided in two steps: by the XML schema and by BREX (Business Rules Exchange).

| Defined by | Content |
| --- | --- |
| XML schema | The type is `emphasisTypeAttType` (based on `xs:string`). The values are an enumeration of 99 values, from `em01` to `em99` |
| Default BREX (BREX-S1-00195) | Allows 6 values (including ranges and patterns) for `//@emphasisType`. The rule applies to all schemas |

Of the values in the XML schema enumeration, the 45 values `em06` to `em50` are not allowed by BREX-S1-00195. They pass XML schema validation, but they are violations in a check against the default BREX.

BREX-S1-00195 allows the following values and defines how a lower-level BREX can tailor each of them.

| Value | `valueForm` | `valueTailoring` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `em01` to `em05` | `single` | `lexical` |
| `em51~em99` | `range` | `restrictable` |

## Meaning of the values

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `em01` | Bold |
| `em02` | Italic. A value for legacy data |
| `em03` | Underline. A value for legacy data |
| `em04` | Overline. Used only to mark vectors |
| `em05` | Strikethrough. Not used to show deleted text |
| `em51` to `em99` | Values whose meaning the project defines |

## In this stack

| Operation | Tool |
| --- | --- |
| Create | The draft of [`build_data_module`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/writer/build-data-module/) has no way to write an emphasis |
| Translate | [`extract_segments`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/writer/extract-segments/) takes out text with each `emphasis` replaced by a placeholder such as `{1}` or `{2}`. [`apply_segments`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/writer/apply-segments/) puts the original elements back into the translated text |
| Check whether a value is allowed | [`lookup_value`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/brex/lookup-value/) |
